aiworkflow.page.warmupConfirm.question: Re-warmup blueprint nodes?
aiworkflow.page.warmupConfirm.yesDesc: Selecting "Yes" will clear all caches, re-render and screenshot all nodes (slower).
aiworkflow.page.warmupConfirm.noDesc: Selecting "No" will load existing caches and use Canvas rendering directly (faster).
aiworkflow.page.missingAsset.title: Missing Asset: File Not Found
aiworkflow.page.missingAsset.description: The system detected that the following static asset no longer exists on disk, but references to it still exist in project data.
This may be due to files being manually moved or deleted, or files not being synced when migrating projects from other devices.
aiworkflow.page.missingAsset.tipRemove: Clicking "Remove Invalid References" will clear the above references from project data (other files on disk will not be deleted). This action can be undone.
aiworkflow.page.missingAsset.tipLater: Clicking "Not Now" will keep the references. You can fix them later via context menu or re-import.
